column1: Mukhyamantri Mahila Rojgar Yojana The Mukhyamantri Mahila Rojgar Yojana was launched in September 2025. The Scheme aims to provide self-employment and livelihood opportunities to women. Under the scheme, financial support is being provided to one woman from each family. An initial grant of Rs 10,000 has been provided to 1.56 crore women. Financial support of up to two lakh rupees may be provided upon starting an enterprise.
